name: hav-theme
description: Frontend assets (tailwind css, leaflet) of the hav stack.

scripts.export_deps:leaflet: /bin/sh -c 'cp -r node_modules/leaflet/dist/images static/theme/ && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js.map static/theme/ && cp src/content/content.js static/theme/'
scripts.export_deps:fonts: /bin/sh -c 'N=node_modules/@fontsource-variable && mkdir -p static/theme/noto-sans/files static/theme/noto-serif-tibetan/files && cp $N/noto-sans/wdth.css $N/noto-sans/wdth-italic.css static/theme/noto-sans/ && cp $N/noto-sans/files/*-wdth-*.woff2 static/theme/noto-sans/files/ && cp $N/noto-serif-tibetan/wght.css static/theme/noto-serif-tibetan/ && cp $N/noto-serif-tibetan/files/*.woff2 static/theme/noto-serif-tibetan/files/'
